biophysical_burden.boundary: Direct disaster loss relative to group GDP; not household wealth or recovery aid.

extent.boundary: Coverage of the LDC comparison group, not all countries or households.

source_locators: UNDRR LDC status: 42 of 44 LDCs report through Sendai Framework Monitor or DesInventar.
UNDRR LDC status: 2015-2024 disaster mortality was 1.76 per 100,000, 2.35 times the global average.
UNDRR LDC status: direct economic loss was 3.22% of GDP versus 0.28% globally, more than eleven times higher.

transformations.formula: Normalize the source-reported LDC direct-economic-loss share of GDP while retaining the global comparator separately.
Normalize the source-reported LDC-to-global mortality multiple; do not convert rates into deaths without population denominators.
Normalize the complete 2015-2024 assessment window once; do not annualize or accumulate group rates.
Divide reporting LDCs by all LDCs and leave the two non-reporting countries missing.

receipts.uncertainty: Sendai reporting definitions, event attribution, valuation, national capacity and completeness vary. The summary compares LDC and global groups; it does not measure household aid eligibility, awards, recovery time, wealth, protected classes or causal discrimination.
receipts.freshness: UNDRR Sendai monitoring data through 2024, status as of 2025-10; snapshot captured 2026-07-31T18:57:18.060Z.

selection_reason.selected_method_passed: UNDRR quantifies persistent cross-income disparity in direct loss relative to GDP and disaster mortality across a ten-year window with 95% LDC reporting coverage.
higher_priority_failures: No current global household recovery-time or post-disaster aid-outcome series supplies magnitude plus threshold or momentum; the operational OpenFEMA comparison is United States-only.
